newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: No Romatex rationalisation seen soon.
newsitem.headline: No Romatex rationalisation seen soon.

text.p: Consolidated Frame Textiles's (Confram) new majority shareholding in Romatex will not lead to any immediate rationalisation of Romatex, the two groups said on Thursday.

"There has been speculation in the media regarding rationalisation prospects, but it should be noted that at this stage, no changes are envisaged," Romatex managing director Mike Hankinson and Confram chairman Mervyn King said in a joint statement.
Confram this week bought 50.1 percent of Romatex for about 28 million rand, with the balance being split between former majority shareholder CG Smith and minorities.
CG Smith now holds about 30 percent in the group.

As part of the deal, King and Confram deputy chairman Roy Sable become non-executive chairman and deputy chairman of Romatex respectively. Hankinson continues as managing director/chief executive of Romatex.
